guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Install the Vangrid App
guide.description: Download the Vangrid App on Android, or open the browser capture tool if you are on iOS. Allow camera and location access, since captures without location data cannot be verified.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Record a Capture That Meets the Spec
guide.description: Film a location a robot would realistically need to cross. Vangrid accepts: Sidewalks and pedestrian paths Stairs and stairwells Alleys and service lanes Public squares and plazas Skip roads, crowds of people, and private indoor spaces. Recording requirements: Hold the phone vertically at chest level, using both hands Walk at a steady pace and pan smoothly from side to side Record 30 to 60 seconds
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enter an Invite Code and Upload
guide.description: Uploads are gated behind an invite code. Enter GRID-01 before uploading. Uploading daily adds a 50-point bonus, with further bonuses at 5, 10, and 50 total videos.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Hub
guide.description: Open the Vangrid Loyalty Hub and connect an EVM wallet. Your first login credits PTC on its own.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Loyalty Hub Quests
guide.description: Work through the quest list: follow Vangrid on X, join the Discord, connect LinkedIn, engage with posts, and publish weekly X posts. Reach Discord through the Hub quest link rather than a forwarded invite. No legitimate verification asks you to sign a wallet transaction, so close any page that does.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Unlock Grid Operator Status
guide.description: Follow Vangrid on X, join the Discord, and submit one in-app video to earn the Grid Operator role and badge, which applies a 1.5x multiplier to your PTC.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Submit to Funded Bounties
guide.description: Browse open requests at the Vangrid bounty portal. These are location-specific asks from buyers, and selected submissions pay USDC on Base. Browsing requires no invite code.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Other Contributors
guide.description: Share your Hub referral link. You earn 10% of the PTC your referrals generate, and each new user who joins through a link starts with a 50 PTC bonus.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
